verdict.rationale: The repo maintains a first-party RELEASE-NOTES.md that describes skill-level changes in detail. Examples include the renamed TDD reference doc (testing-anti-patterns.md → writing-good-tests.md), changed worktree-removal behavior, the plan-scoped sdd-workspace, and new harness install support. That gives developers a readable record of what changed in the skills before updating. Missing for 10: evidence that notes are tied to explicit version numbers or tagged releases, notes surfaced at update time (e.g., via the plugin update flow), and independent or community corroboration that the changelog is reliably maintained.
